# Creek Construction

Creek Construction is a residential exterior construction contractor serving Edmonton Metro, Calgary Metro, and the Okanagan, BC.

## Core Services

- Siding
- Exterior paint and sanding
- Decks
- Platforms
- Outdoor fireplaces
- Sheds
- Gutter cleaning
- Roof repairs
- New roof builds
- Fences
- Exterior fixtures
- Landscaping
- Walkways
- Backyard gardens
- Driveway pressure cleaning
- Garage builds

## Service Areas

Creek Construction serves Edmonton, St. Albert, Sherwood Park, Stony Plain, Spruce Grove, Leduc, Nisku, Calgary, Cochrane, Airdrie, Kelowna, West Kelowna, Peachland, Summerland, Penticton, and Vernon.

## Trust Signals

Creek Construction provides written quotes, works with the same crew customers meet, and serves residential exterior construction projects across Alberta and the Okanagan.

## Quote Path

Visitors can request a free written quote from the site header, service buttons, contact page form, footer CTA, or by calling (780) 777-5178.
